description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetPeriodSubscriber class, which subscribes to request events in the OrangeHRM application's time plugin. It handles request filtering based on URL paths to enforce timesheet period configuration logic, including forwarding and access control.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens to kernel request events to control access and forwarding based on timesheet period configuration in the OrangeHRM time plugin.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events to which this subscriber is subscribed, specifically the kernel request event with a priority of 100.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP request events, checks if the request is for the time plugin or API, and enforces timesheet period configuration rules by forwarding or throwing exceptions based on the current configuration state.
